PanelDescription.SourceString: 你收到了一位朋友的邀请，去六队的办公室看看吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: A friend has invited you over to see them. Head to the ETD-6 Office and see what's up.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 曳尔沐特意邀请你来，会是为了什么呢？
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Elyms went out of her way to invite you over. What could she want?

PanelDescription.SourceString: 像曳尔沐说的那样，摸一摸这只猫咪的肉垫吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: As Elyms suggested, try touching the cat's paw pads.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 原来这只猫咪是谜皮鬼变的，真是稀奇……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: So this cat was a Mysty all along… That's pretty wild…

PanelDescription.SourceString: 曳尔沐要晚到片刻，先去找小谜聊一聊吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Elyms will be a little late, so go speak with Little Mysty first.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 和异象聊天的机会可不常有，听听小谜对其他人的看法吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: You don't get many chances to chat with an Anomaly. Hear what Little Mysty thinks of everyone else.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 呼呼咯咯（但，像泡泡一样的那家伙也说……）
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Hoo-hoo, kekeke… (But the one who's like bubbles also said…)

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 呼呼咯咯（这样或许是能得到一个在管理局的稳定位置，但实质上却又变回了做宠物而已，要不要再重新思考一下？）
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Hoo-hoo, kekeke (Maybe this would give me a stable position at the Bureau, but wouldn't I just end up as a pet again, when you really boil it down? Maybe I should reconsider…)

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 呼呼咯咯（她让我一边去观察她的同伴们，和他们相处，一边想自己到底需要什么……）
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Hoo-hoo, kekeke (She encouraged me to observe her companions, spend time with them, and then really think about what I want…)

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 嘿嘿咯咯（背电视机的女孩、喜欢钓鱼的大哥、头发会动的小姐姐、住机房里的怪家伙……）
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Hoo-hoo, kekeke (The girl with a TV on her back, the older guy who likes fishing, the young woman who has hair that moves, and the weird guy who lives in the server room…)

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 嘿嘿咯咯（我最近在思考……思考……）
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Hoo-hoo, kekeke! (I've been thinking lately… thinking really hard…)

PanelDescription.SourceString: 小谜思考的东西比想象中还多，跟着它走走吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Little Mysty has more on its mind than you might think. Follow it around for a while to learn more.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 曳尔沐给小谜准备了两个问题，但只说出了一个。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Elyms had two questions for Little Mysty, but only managed to ask one.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 曳尔沐联系到了小谜的失主，去看看情况吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Elyms has contacted Little Mysty's owner. See how things are going.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 于虚构之物中，真实存在的是什么呢？
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: What is real within something fake?
